title: 薄层色谱
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/173_薄层色谱.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/173_薄层色谱/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一块点了彩色斑点的薄层板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small white chromatography plate with a few colored spots in a column, standing beside a fume hood, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十一课：薄层色谱。

shots.scene: 阿杰在开放台面倒展开剂，旁边亮着加热板
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours a solvent into a glass jar on an open bench next to a glowing hot plate, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面倒溶剂，旁边还开着电热板。

shots.scene: 他用手指捏着板面，用圆珠笔画线，液面淹过斑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fingers pinching the face of a plate, a ballpoint pen line, and solvent in a jar higher than the spots, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 手捏板面、钢笔画线，液面还淹过点。

shots.scene: 他凑近直视亮着的紫外灯，小研拦住
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student as he leans in to stare straight at a glowing handheld ultraviolet lamp.
shots.narration: 小研：别直视紫外灯！一步步来。

shots.scene: 薄层色谱：有机实验的常用分析法
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small chromatography plate in the center with four icons around it, identify, purity, reaction progress and purification. No text.
shots.narration: 薄层色谱，有机实验最常用的分析法。

shots.scene: 又快又省，适合不易挥发的样品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopwatch, a tiny sample drop and a non volatile solid icon beside the plate, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 又快又省样，适合不易挥发的样品。

shots.scene: 确认产物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a product spot on the plate matching a reference spot, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 做完反应，点一块板就能确认产物。

shots.scene: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a lab manual and points at a principle diagram before the hands on work.
shots.narration: 先懂原理再动手，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 萃取看溶解度，蒸馏看沸点，色谱看极性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a separatory funnel, a distillation flask and a chromatography plate, each with a different property symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 萃取靠溶解度，蒸馏靠沸点，色谱靠极性。

shots.scene: 固定相是吸附层，流动相是展开剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate cross section with a fixed white adsorbent layer and a solvent moving upward through it by capillary action. No text.
shots.narration: 吸附层不动是固定相，展开剂是流动相。

shots.scene: 极性小的跑得快，极性大的被拉住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two molecules moving up, a nonpolar one running far ahead and a polar one held back by attraction to the adsorbent. No text.
shots.narration: 极性小跑得快，极性大被吸住跑得慢。

shots.scene: 底板上涂一层极性吸附剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin layer of white silica adsorbent coated on a backing sheet, with a magnified polar surface. No text.
shots.narration: 薄层板：底板上涂一层极性吸附剂。

shots.scene: 多数掺了荧光剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plate glowing green under an ultraviolet icon because of a fluorescent additive. No text.
shots.narration: 多数还掺了荧光剂，便于紫外显色。

shots.scene: 塑料板便宜，剪刀就能剪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plastic backed plate cut to size with scissors, a low price tag icon. No text.
shots.narration: 塑料背衬板便宜，用剪刀就能剪。

shots.scene: 玻璃板耐热、分得更好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass backed plate beside a heat icon and sharper separated spots, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃板更耐热，分离也常常更好。

shots.scene: 大玻璃板切成几十块小板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large square glass plate divided by pencil lines into long strips and then into many small plates. No text.
shots.narration: 大玻璃板能切出几十块小板。

shots.scene: 戴护目镜、防割手套，涂层朝下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student in safety goggles and cut resistant gloves placing the plate coated side down on a clean dry bench, marking lines with pencil and ruler. No text.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜防割手套，涂层面朝下。

shots.scene: 玻璃刀一次划过，借台边掰断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass cutter making one firm stroke along a ruler, then the score line placed on the bench edge and pressed to snap. No text.
shots.narration: 玻璃刀一次划透，借台边一压就断。

shots.scene: 碎屑用刷子簸箕清进碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small glass chips and white coating dust brushed into a dustpan and emptied into a broken glass box, bare hands crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 碎屑和粉尘用刷子扫，进碎玻璃盒。

shots.scene: 细玻璃点样管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bundle of very thin glass spotting capillaries, ready made, beside a self made thinner one. No text.
shots.narration: 点样用很细的玻璃点样管。

shots.scene: 自拉的更细，斑点更小
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thinner capillary making a smaller spot and fitting more lanes on one plate, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 自拉的更细，斑点小，一块板点更多。

shots.scene: 火焰旁不放易燃溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small blue flame in a fume hood with solvent bottles moved far away, the area clear. No text.
shots.narration: 拉管要用火，周围移走易燃溶剂。

shots.scene: 中部烤软，移出火焰再拉开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the middle of a capillary softened in a blue flame, moved out of the flame and pulled apart into two thin tips. No text.
shots.narration: 中部烤软，移出火焰再向两端拉。

shots.scene: 热玻璃看不出烫，放耐热垫冷却
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: freshly pulled glass looking normal but with heat waves, placed on a heat resistant pad, a bare hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 热玻璃看不出烫，放耐热垫上冷却。

shots.scene: 滴管拉制跟有经验的人学
shots.prompt_en: The older man shows the young male student a safe workspace, a glass dropper on a heat resistant pad, nodding as a teacher.
shots.narration: 用滴管拉制有风险，跟有经验的人学。

shots.scene: 带盖玻璃展开缸、滤纸、展开剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glass jar with a tight lid, a strip of filter paper and a small bottle of developing solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 展开缸：带盖玻璃瓶、滤纸、展开剂。

shots.scene: 镊子、铅笔、直尺、点样管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tweezers, a pencil, a ruler and spotting capillaries laid out beside the plate. No text.
shots.narration: 镊子、铅笔、直尺、点样管也备好。

shots.scene: 样品多就选宽一些的板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a narrow plate with two lanes and a wider plate with four lanes, more sample vials pointing to the wide one. No text.
shots.narration: 样品多，就选宽一点的板。

shots.scene: 取溶剂、放板取板、晾干都在通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pouring solvent, placing and removing the plate and drying it, all inside a fume hood with the sash at the marked height. No text.
shots.narration: 倒溶剂、放板取板、晾干都在柜内。

shots.scene: 头不伸进去，柜内不堆杂物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a head inside the hood and clutter blocking the baffles, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 头别伸进柜，柜里不堆杂物挡气流。

shots.scene: 展开剂易燃，远离明火热源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent bottle with a flammable pictogram, a flame and a glowing hot plate kept far away. No text.
shots.narration: 展开剂多易燃，远离明火和热源。

shots.scene: 用多少取多少，随开随盖，戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small measured amount poured into a cylinder, the bottle capped right away, safety goggles and gloves icons. No text.
shots.narration: 用多少取多少，随开随盖，戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 【实拍】滤纸平贴缸壁
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a strip of filter paper slid into a glass jar and pressed flat against the inside wall.
shots.narration: 先把滤纸放进缸里，平贴缸壁。

shots.scene: 【实拍】倒入浅浅一层展开剂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a shallow layer of clear liquid about half a centimeter deep poured into the jar bottom.
shots.narration: 倒入浅浅一层，五到八毫米深。

shots.scene: 倾斜润湿滤纸，盖上盖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the jar tilted so the liquid wets the filter paper, then the lid closed. No text.
shots.narration: 倾斜润湿滤纸，盖上盖子。

shots.scene: 缸内蒸气饱和，静置几分钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the closed jar filled with vapor dots from the wet paper, a clock showing a few minutes. No text.
shots.narration: 静置几分钟，缸里充满溶剂蒸气。

shots.scene: 只拿边缘，戴手套也不碰板面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloved fingers holding a plate only by its edges, a fingertip touching the coated face crossed out with an oily smudge. No text.
shots.narration: 只拿边缘，手上油污会沾到板上。

shots.scene: 在涂层面操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the coated dull side of the plate facing up and highlighted, the shiny backing side facing down. No text.
shots.narration: 标记点样都在有涂层的那一面。

shots.scene: 只用铅笔，不用钢笔
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pencil checked, a ballpoint pen crossed out with ink climbing up the plate with the solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 只用铅笔，墨水会跟着溶剂跑。

shots.scene: 【实拍】距底约一厘米，轻画起始线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved fingers hold a plate by its edges while a pencil lightly draws a straight line about one centimeter above the bottom along a ruler.
shots.narration: 距底约一厘米轻画起始线，别刮破。

shots.scene: 线太低会被溶剂冲走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an origin line drawn too close to the bottom with spots washed into the solvent, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 线太低，样品会被溶剂直接冲走。

shots.scene: 在线上标出均匀分开的点位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four small pencil tick marks evenly spaced along the origin line, each lane given an icon. No text.
shots.narration: 线上标出点位，间距均匀做好记号。

shots.scene: 别靠边，别太挤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spot too close to the plate edge running crooked and two spots too close merging, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 离边太近会跑偏，太挤斑点会重叠。

shots.scene: 已知、混合、未知样各占一位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four sample vials, two references, one mixture and one unknown, each matched to a lane. No text.
shots.narration: 两个标准品、混合物和未知样。

shots.scene: 样品配稀一些
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dilute sample solution in a small vial, a very faint spot and a heavy streaking spot both crossed out on either side. No text.
shots.narration: 样品要稀：太稀看不见，太浓会拖尾。

shots.scene: 【实拍】点样管轻触起始线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a thin capillary dipped into a colored dye solution, then lightly and quickly touched to a tick mark on the origin line, leaving a tiny spot.
shots.narration: 蘸一点，在点位上轻快一碰。

shots.scene: 干了再点，一般一到三次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the spot drying between touches, a small counter showing one to three applications. No text.
shots.narration: 等溶剂挥发再点，一般一到三次。

shots.scene: 斑点直径一两毫米，越小越好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny one to two millimeter spot checked, a large spreading spot from holding the tube too long crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 斑点直径一两毫米，越小分得越清。

shots.scene: 一样一管，斑点分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separate capillary for each sample vial, a single shared capillary crossed out, the spots kept apart. No text.
shots.narration: 换样品就换管，斑点不能连在一起。

shots.scene: 【实拍】镊子夹板放进展开缸
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: tweezers hold the dried plate by its top edge and lower it gently into the jar, the shallow liquid below the pencil line.
shots.narration: 斑点干了，用镊子把板放进缸。

shots.scene: 液面必须低于起始线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solvent level below the origin line checked, a level above the line dissolving the spots into the pool crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 液面一定要低于起始线。

shots.scene: 盖好盖，板边不碰滤纸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the lid closed and the plate standing clear of the filter paper, a plate touching the paper with a crooked front crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 马上盖盖，板边别碰滤纸。

shots.scene: 静静等待，不摇不碰
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solvent climbing the plate in a still closed jar, a hand shaking the jar crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 静静等待，别摇别碰展开缸。

shots.scene: 盯住前沿，离顶端留五到十毫米
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the solvent front rising and stopping about half to one centimeter below the top of the plate. No text.
shots.narration: 盯住前沿，离顶端留五到十毫米。

shots.scene: 跑到顶就算不准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a front that has reached the very top of the plate, crossed out because the distance can no longer be measured. No text.
shots.narration: 跑到顶，比移值就没法算准。

shots.scene: 【实拍】取出，立刻铅笔标前沿
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: tweezers lift the plate out of the jar inside a fume hood and a pencil quickly marks the wet solvent front line.
shots.narration: 取出后，趁湿立刻标出前沿。

shots.scene: 在通风柜内彻底晾干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plate resting on a clean surface inside the fume hood until fully dry, the jar closed. No text.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里，让板彻底晾干。

shots.scene: 有色物质直接看，多数看不见
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate with one colored spot visible and other invisible spots shown as dotted outlines. No text.
shots.narration: 有颜色的直接看，多数却看不见。

shots.scene: 紫外灯下荧光背景上现出暗斑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside an enclosed ultraviolet viewing box, the plate glows green and dark spots appear where the compounds are. No text.
shots.narration: 放到紫外灯下，暗斑就显出来了。

shots.scene: 用暗箱或戴防紫外护目镜，不直视灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an enclosed viewing box checked, ultraviolet protective goggles checked, eyes staring at the lamp crossed out, ordinary glasses crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用暗箱或戴防紫外眼镜，不直视灯。

shots.scene: 手少在灯下停留，用完关灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand under the lamp with a short timer icon, the lamp switched off after use. No text.
shots.narration: 手别久照，用完马上关灯。

shots.scene: 铅笔圈出每个斑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pencil circling each dark spot on the plate. No text.
shots.narration: 用铅笔把每个斑点圈下来。

shots.scene: 紫外看不见，用显色剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate with nothing visible under ultraviolet, an arrow to a row of stain bottles. No text.
shots.narration: 紫外下看不见，还可以用显色剂。

shots.scene: 染色是破坏性的，先看紫外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an order arrow, ultraviolet check first, then stain, a reversed order crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 染色不可逆，一定先看紫外再染色。

shots.scene: 显色剂多有毒腐蚀，在通风柜内操作
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: stain bottles with corrosive and oxidizer pictograms inside a fume hood, goggles and gloves icons, an open bench crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 显色剂多有毒腐蚀，在通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 溶剂挥干后，镊子夹板浸入、沥干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dry developed plate held with tweezers dipped briefly into a stain jar, excess dripping back, the back wiped on a paper towel. No text.
shots.narration: 挥干后，镊子夹板浸一下、沥干。

shots.scene: 热风枪加热，不对人不对瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plate warmed above a heat gun until spots appear, the nozzle pointed at a person or a solvent bottle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 热风加热显色，风口不对人不对瓶。

shots.scene: 别烤黑，多试几种显色剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overheated blackened plate crossed out, then the same compounds tried with several stains, one showing clear spots. No text.
shots.narration: 加热过头会发黑，不显就换几种试。

shots.scene: 同条件下同一化合物比移值相同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two plates run under the same conditions with the same compound spot at the same height. No text.
shots.narration: 条件相同，同一化合物比移值一样。

shots.scene: A：起始线到斑点中心
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ruler measuring from the origin line to the center of a spot, the distance labeled with a letter icon. No text.
shots.narration: A：起始线到斑点中心的距离。

shots.scene: B：起始线到溶剂前沿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ruler measuring from the origin line to the solvent front line. No text.
shots.narration: B：起始线到溶剂前沿的距离。

shots.scene: Rf＝A÷B，在零和一之间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple division icon of the shorter distance over the longer distance giving a value between zero and one. No text.
shots.narration: 比移值等于A除以B，不会超过一。

shots.scene: 别从板底量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ruler measuring from the bottom edge of the plate crossed out, the correct start at the origin line checked. No text.
shots.narration: 从起始线量，别从板底量。

shots.scene: 极性越大，比移值越小
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a polar compound spot low on the plate and a nonpolar compound spot high on the plate. No text.
shots.narration: 化合物极性越大，比移值越小。

shots.scene: 展开剂极性加大，斑点都走得更远
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same samples on two plates, a more polar solvent mixture moving all spots higher. No text.
shots.narration: 展开剂极性加大，斑点普遍走得更远。

shots.scene: 单一溶剂分不开，按比例混合
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one plate with all spots stuck low, one with all spots at the top, and a mixed solvent plate with two well separated spots. No text.
shots.narration: 一种太弱一种太强，混合就分开了。

shots.scene: 比移值在零点二到零点八最好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plate with a highlighted band from two tenths to eight tenths of the way up, spots inside it checked. No text.
shots.narration: 比移值在零点二到零点八最好。

shots.scene: 按样品选展开剂，分不开调极性
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solvent dial adjusting polarity until two close spots move apart. No text.
shots.narration: 按样品选展开剂，分不开就调极性。

shots.scene: 不同板之间有偏差
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same compound on two different plates at slightly different heights, a caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 不同板之间，比移值会有偏差。

shots.scene: 要比较就点在同一块板上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: references and unknown spotted side by side on a single plate, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 要比较，就点在同一块板上。

shots.scene: 混合物两个点，未知样与B齐平
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a developed plate where reference B runs higher than A, the mixture shows two spots and the unknown spot lines up with B. No text.
shots.narration: 混合物出两个点，未知样和B一样高。

shots.scene: 很可能是B；A走得近，极性更大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the unknown linked to B with a likely check mark and a confirm with other methods icon, an arrow noting A is more polar. No text.
shots.narration: 未知样很可能是B，A极性更大。

shots.scene: 每块板三个点位：未知、已知、共点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two plates with three lanes each, unknown, known reference, and a center lane where both are spotted on top of each other. No text.
shots.narration: 共点法：未知、已知、两者叠点。

shots.scene: 先点已知并晾干，换样前洗管
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the known spotted in the center and side lanes and dried, the capillary emptied and rinsed with clean solvent before the unknown. No text.
shots.narration: 先点已知晾干，换样前洗净点样管。

shots.scene: 和A共点出现两个斑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plate with reference A where the co spot lane splits into two spots, a not the same cross. No text.
shots.narration: 和A叠点出两个斑点，不是A。

shots.scene: 和B共点只有一个斑点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the plate with reference B where the co spot lane shows one single spot, a match check. No text.
shots.narration: 和B叠点只有一个，未知物就是B。

shots.scene: 反应中途取样点板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reaction flask sampled at several times, each sample spotted on a plate beside the starting material. No text.
shots.narration: 反应中途取样点板，追踪进度。

shots.scene: 原料斑点消失，反应完成
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a series of plates where the starting material spot fades and disappears while the product spot grows. No text.
shots.narration: 原料斑点没了，反应就完成了。

shots.scene: 挑分得最好的展开剂用于柱色谱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several plates with different solvent mixtures, the best separated one chosen with an arrow to a glass chromatography column. No text.
shots.narration: 挑分得最好的展开剂，用到柱色谱。

shots.scene: 用过的展开剂进有机废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used developing solvent poured from the jar into a labeled organic waste container in the fume hood, a sink crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的展开剂，倒进有机废液桶。

shots.scene: 标前沿、紫外圈点、算比移值

shots.narration: 标前沿，圈斑点，从起始线算比移值。

shots.scene: 通风柜、远离火源、护眼、废物分类

shots.narration: 通风柜里操作，远离火源，护好眼睛。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在装好的色谱柱旁
